# Datos {menu-title="Clasificación POI"}

::: {.subtitle}

Clasificación de Point of Interest

:::

:::: {.clasificacion-main}

::: {.clasificacion-sub width="50%"}

::: {.dato-tipo}

Área de baja accesibilidad

:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| class: fig-class

from pathlib import Path
from scrips import clasificador_poi, grafico_categorias, poi_total_area
import json

main_path = Path.cwd().resolve()

data_place_file = (
    main_path
    / "Data"
    / "Area Baja"
    / "Data Places"
    / "01M1A6FZMJSQ.json"
)

with open(data_place_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data_places = json.load(f)

poly_id = list(data_places.keys())[0]

clasificador = clasificador_poi(
    data_places=data_places[poly_id]
)

fig = grafico_categorias(clasificador["cat_count"])
fig
```

::: {.area-poi-desc}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

n_pois = poi_total_area(
    data_places=data_places,
    poly_id=poly_id
)

texto_area = f"""
<div class="area-poi-desc-box">
🏢 <b>POI identificados:</b> {n_pois}<br>
</div>
"""

print(texto_area)
```

Clasificación de Point of Interest

::: {.dato-tipo}

Área de alta accesibilidad

:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| class: fig-class-alta

data_place_file = (
    main_path
    / "Data"
    / "Area Alta"
    / "Data Places"
    / "01KTYZJYNBDM.json"
)

with open(data_place_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data_places = json.load(f)

poly_id = list(data_places.keys())[0]

clasificador = clasificador_poi(
    data_places=data_places[poly_id]
)

fig = grafico_categorias(clasificador["cat_count"])
fig.set_size_inches(10, 8)
fig
```

